title: Reporting Analyst III
description:
Title: Credit Risk Professional
Location: New York, NY
Duration: 12+ months

Business Overview:
"RISK Strategic Governance & Credit Platform” (RISK SGCP) is a transversal team within the Global Risk Function covering all businesses, countries where the Group is established. At the North America regional (NAR) level, RISK SGCP's main missions are centered on:
  • Credit portfolio Analysis and Risk Reporting,
  • Data Management,
  • Strategic risk analysis, including coordination of Risk forums,
  • Risk ID, anticipation and RAS stress testing
 
Within RISK SGCP, the responsibilities of the "Credit Portfolio Analysis and Risk Reporting” are comprised around below areas:
  • Monitor and analyze the evolution of the Bank's credit risk portfolio for NAR including identification and assessment of the portfolio dynamics over time (including risk appetite metrics, ad-hoc "deep dives”, etc.)
  • Production of dashboards and Credit risk information to be communicated to external and internal stakeholders including General Management, Board of Directors, Internal management committees, Regulators, Head Office.
  • Key liaison and support for RISK Corporate that includes production of analysis and reports covering their portfolio, KRIs.
  • Review and improvement of underlying data contributing to Credit risk and participation to help remediate the issues as needed.
  • Contribute to ad hoc projects that enable more efficient ways to analyze and use Credit risk data.
  
Responsibilities:
  • To help produce, analyze and compile credit risk information to serve the needs of internal (Banks' Board of Directors, Senior Management, CRO, RISK Corporate, Head Office) and external stakeholders (various Supervisors).
  • To analyze in close coordination with the Risk practitioners the evolution of the credit portfolio quality (with focus on Leveraged Lending), understand its trends and dynamics and contribute to the anticipation of any adverse development being it in a sector, geography, métier, etc.
  • To assist in the building of a comprehensive framework of credit portfolio risk analytics and to deliver to the senior management focused and timely credit portfolio information meant to enlighten decision makers on current and forward looking credit portfolio risks.
  • Contribute to the Bank's Risk Appetite Framework such as the RAS, the Risk identification for Credit & Counterparty Risks.
  • To contribute to topics between Business and RISK when reviewing Business strategies and their impact on the credit and counterparty risk profile, notably in the RAS review, Group Budget and Strat Plan exercises, and to accompany them with relevant information and analysis of credit portfolio risks.
  • To contribute to the budgetary and risk identification exercises by providing relevant information and analysis of credit portfolio risks.
  • To identify and raise any data quality issues impacting the credit portfolio and help with remediation by working with Data Quality team.
  • Contribute to ongoing projects that enhance credit risk analysis, underlying data and finding ways to perform tasks more efficiently through automation, streamlining, etc.
 
Minimum Required Qualifications
  • Good knowledge of credit and counterparty risks
  • Good reporting software skills
  • Good organization skills to manage under tight deadlines the complexity of processes and the high number of stakeholders to coordinate
  • Strong analytical and inquisitive mindset in order to synthesize large amount of information in management level presentations
  • Excellent communication skills, and ability to present comprehensive risk reviews to Senior Management
  • Ability to contribute to value-added projects on a long term basis,
  • Sense of details, accuracy and presentation without losing the "main picture”
  • Commitment to deliver results in line with client's expectations
  • Resilience to heavy workload
 
Preferred Qualifications;  
  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Risk management or Management Information System area
  • Degree in Finance or related area

As a Technical Consultant, you will leverage your deep technical expertise to own complex integrations, understand and configure the application environment, contribute to our data lake strategy, and develop comprehensive reporting and dashboarding solutions. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on how *** manages its workforce, driving efficiency and accuracy in a large-scale enterprise environment. Responsibilities: • Integration Ownership: Design, develop, implement, and maintain robust integrations between WorkForce Software and various internal and external systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process synchronization. This includes utilizing web services (SOAP, REST) and other integration technologies. • Application Environment Expertise: Possess in-depth knowledge of WorkForce Software configuration, modules (Time, Scheduling, Integrations), and functionalities to effectively tailor the system to ***'s specific business requirements and policies. • Data Lake Contribution: Collaborate with data architecture teams to ensure WorkForce Software data is accurately captured, transformed, and integrated into ***'s data lake, supporting advanced analytics and insights. • Reporting & Dashboarding: Lead the design, development, and implementation of custom reports and dashboards within WorkForce Software, providing key stakeholders with actionable insights into workforce data, timekeeping metrics, and compliance. • Technical Consultation: Provide expert technical guidance and support throughout the project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. • Troubleshooting & Optimization: Identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical issues related to WorkForce Software, integrations, and data processes, ensuring system stability and optimal performance. • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including integration specifications, configuration guides, and reporting logic. • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, IT, Labor Affairs, and analytics teams, to ensure alignment and successful project delivery.

System Design, Systems Engineering, Testing, SaaS, Workforce Management, Software Documentation, SQL, Oracle, Web Applications, System Administration, Six Sigma Methodology, Warehousing, Access Controls, API, GCP

N/A
